signals.text: Youth star JJ Gabriel, 15, on brink of leaving Man Utd. Manchester United's highly-rated 15-year-old forward JJ Gabriel is on the verge of leaving the club.

Barcelona monitor Kane & Haaland - Wednesday's gossip. Barcelona are monitoring Harry Kane and Erling Haaland, Nick Woltemade could be a replacement for Kane at Bayern Munich, and Manchester United are interested in Jarrad Branthwaite, plus more.
Bellamy 'committed' to Wales after Burnley talks. Craig Bellamy says he was "comfortable" turning down the chance to return to club football and reiterated his desire to continue with Wales.
